title: Wasserstein Estimation of the Population Law of CATE over Categorical Covariates
banked_reason: The proposal's full sparse-to-dense frontier with a constructed probability-valued estimator and matching converse remains an explicit to-prove obligation; the delivered dense frontier and logarithmic bracket are a strictly weaker kernel.
gap_reasons: The proposal's full sparse-to-dense rho(n,d) frontier with a constructed probability-valued estimator and matching converse is still an explicit to-prove obligation; the delivered dense frontier and logarithmic bracket are a strictly weaker kernel.
The grouped reconstruction procedure is merely a blueprint, so it supplies neither the promised improved estimator nor an achievable sparse-regime rate.
The delivered dense theorem, coarse bracket, and parametric-risk boundary constitute a companion result rather than the field-level full-frontier contribution named in the brief.
proof_attempt_summary: Two D0 solve rounds established the dense d/n frontier, an all-regime factor-log(ed) bracket, a four-regime lower-benchmark phase diagram, and the bounded-category parametric-risk boundary. The grouped positive moment reconstruction could not be upgraded from a blueprint to a uniformly controlled probability-valued estimator, and no matching converse selected the exact sparse/transitional rate. The exact frontier therefore remains open; no Lean formalization was started.
tldr: High-dimensional categorical adjustment makes every CATE location a difference of two armwise ratios, while the same unknown cell mass controls both sampling information and the atom's target weight.  On the unchanged observational model class, the paper proves the uniform logarithmic characterization \(c_\epsilon L_{n,d}\le R_{n,d,\epsilon}\le C_\epsilon\log(ed)L_{n,d}\), the exact \(d/n\) dense frontier when \(n\ge d^3\), and the exact bounded-category parametric-risk boundary, using the explicit total empirical probability-valued estimator for achievability.  The exact sparse-to-dense frontier remains open: grouped reconstruction is an explicit candidate blueprint, not a delivered estimator, until its split, tuning, factorial statistics, covariance control, finite program, fallback, and matching same-class converse are supplied.
gap: Existing causal theory treats scalar averages, while population-of-parameters theory fixes entity weights or trial counts. Neither literature determines the squared \(W_1\) risk of the population-weighted categorical CATE law when masses, propensities, and both arm regressions are unknown.
fill: The paper supplies observed-law identification, a mass-weighted Lipschitz extension, a computable empirical estimator, two complementary lower constructions, the exact dense and parametric-risk boundaries, and a concrete positive grouped-moment handle for resolving the remaining frontier.
